_comment: Presentation only: nearby non-colliding leaf surfaces fade only when their per-instance projected bounds overlap the trainer corridor. A bounds test is conservative, not an exact leaf-depth/ray test. No placements, bake inputs, harvest state or colliders change. Validate native Compatibility motion before accepting.

near_lens_fade._why: F10#2 (coordinator, 13 Oct): the fight camera's lens entered Stormwood bark/canopy reaching past trunk colliders. Every surface of these tree models dithers out near the lens. Presentation only. TUNABLE. Attempt 2 (13 Oct): 1.5/4 m left giant canopies covering half of Capacitor's frames (judge 3/10); widened to 3/7 m and storm bush/fern added.

line_of_sight_fade._why: F10#2 (READY, CPU-provisional r8 6.77, C3 6/6): while a Stormwood fight runs, supported StandardMaterial surfaces of the listed models dither out along the lens-to-fighter sight lines and inside the fight's own near-lens band (near_lens_invisible_below_m to near_lens_opaque_above_m). Exploration keeps near_lens_fade's baked band and models unchanged. No render-instance removal, collider, harvest, scale or bake changes. GPU pass still to confirm 7.5.
line_of_sight_fade._why_r2: F10#2 round 1 (three code-blind judges, CPU): this candidate 6.17 vs control 5.14, C3 6/6 vs 3/6. Remaining asks: canopy still washes the top of the frame (wider lens band and corridor while the candidate runs), dark arenas lose the small pilot (a soft unshadowed fill light follows the piloted creature). Presentation only.
line_of_sight_fade._why_r7: r7 (coordinator): judges asked for the dark forest floor to read; the pilot fill light widens to a 9 m pool from 3.5 m up (energy 2.4) so the floor around both fighters lifts at the C3 cameras. Proof-only for capture: the Stormwood named lane rows also use Fights' cue_lane_* / cue_impact_burst hooks (tb/fights 9366c0230, ea1ea3316).
line_of_sight_fade._why_r3: F10#2 round 2 (three judges, CPU): 6.14 vs round 1 6.17, flat; trunks still hide both fighters at Old Rodfolk's impact and the solver kept blocked orbits. Round 3 (clearly different approach): the fight-camera solver refuses a lens whose line to either fighter's torso meets world colliders (trunks, rocks), choosing a clear orbit; the fade keeps handling non-colliding canopy.
line_of_sight_fade._why_r4: F10#2 round 4 (56 px HUD keep-out while the candidate runs) scored 6.17 against round 3's 6.60 with fresh judges; reverted. The code path stays inert without hud_margin_px.
line_of_sight_fade._why_enabled_realms: 'enabled' turns this on for every listed realm; 'enabled_realms' for only those. ON for Stormwood (F10#2 READY r8). The Meadows ('playground', F22#4 Riverwatch draw) stays OFF until that fight's in-world judge passes.
line_of_sight_fade._why_r8: r8 (coordinator, after r7 6.694): judges asked for steadier distance, a stronger pilot marker and a brighter floor. named_max_distance_m caps the fight lens for each Stormwood named wild (by named_encounter_id) so the far pull-outs stop; the contact ring is thicker, paler and drawn over the ground; the rim is stronger; the pilot fill light is a wider, brighter pool. Cone/ring tell fill has no hook (soft telegraph style), so it is not part of this round.
line_of_sight_fade._why_r6: F10#2 round 6 (coordinator; r3 6.60, CPU plateau): one batch on the judges' asks. The solver may not pull back so far that the piloted creature's rendered height drops under 7% of the frame (keeps the small pilot findable; floored at the base 9.5 m); the pilot gets its own silhouette rim (creature_body._rim_light_node, the existing field/alpha rim path, cleared when the fight ends) and a pale cyan contact ring at its feet. Only while this candidate runs.
